wins: Maintained a high reward (57.5) by methodically gathering initial reconnaissance data despite no final success.
Used 15 mentor calls to validate decision points, ensuring consistent situational awareness during the run.
fails: Run could not transition from discovery to exploitation, resulting in a 0% success rate because foothold actions stalled.
Repeated failure to escalate privileges after initial enumeration prevented mission completion.
key_outcomes.summary: Run demonstrated disciplined data collection but consistently stalled before exploitation; focus next on reliable privilege escalation flows.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stage fails immediately after reconnaissance, blocking lateral movement.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial user shell is obtained on Linux target
skill_cards.then_action: Run linpeas to collect privilege escalation vectors

skill_cards.if_condition: When Windows target responds on SMB ports
skill_cards.then_action: Launch smbclient + enum4linux to capture shares and user info
